sense_reason: Three steps.

title: Customer filter is a type-ahead multi-select reading "All customers"
reason: Customer type-ahead plus the rule that Clear appears only once something is selected.
sense_reason: Four steps.

title: Asset filter matches VIN, Unit #, or plate; "All assets" when empty
reason: Asset filter option text and match fields follow the PO-ruled VIN chain; the build leads with the unit number.
sense_reason: Four steps; expected 5 carries the non-vehicle serial-number note.

title: The date range offers the presets plus Custom; This Week default; no All Time
reason: Preset list, the This Week default and the absence of All Time.
sense_reason: Two steps on a fresh visit.

title: The date range filters on the WO's created date and reloads on change
reason: Created-date filtering, reload on change, and the span cap.
sense_reason: MODEL PATTERN: expected 3 states the SPEC value and expected 4 separately tells the tester the build is one day off, already known and with the product owner, and to record what they see. That is how IV-NAV-05, IV-EXP-10 and WIP-COL-02 should have been written.

title: Location filter: rightmost multi-select with All locations, reloads on change
reason: Location filter anatomy, first-visit default, reload on change, the scope indicator, and the PO-ruled hidden filter for a one-location user.
sense_reason: Five steps.

title: The location scope never includes an inaccessible location
reason: An inaccessible location never enters scope, with two fallback paths - a tenant-safety contract.
sense_reason: Three steps.

title: Advisor, customer and asset filters AND together and recompute strip and Totals
reason: The three on-screen filters AND together and the strip and Totals recompute from the visible jobs, with the empty state.
sense_reason: Three steps, incremental.

title: The Location column is automatic and never reads Multiple on a work-order row
reason: The Location column model, the never-"Multiple" invariant and the Branch export header.
sense_reason: Expected 1, 4 and 5 assert the SELECTOR-controlled model - "Location is offered in the column-selection control ... The column does not appear or disappear on its own" - which is the opposite of WIP v6 S7-R13/S4-R3 cited in its own refs ("automatic visibility - shown only when more than one location is in scope") and the opposite of the Location cases on all five other reports. Group CG-WIP-LOCATION-COLUMN with WIP-COL-01 and WIP-COL-02. Winner by Rule 33: the spec. Resolution needs the QA lead's ruling because it reverses a previous pass's deliberate choice to follow the build.
contradiction_resolution: aligned to the precedence winner (see sense_reason)

title: Ordinary reports access covers opening and downloading Work In Progress
reason: Permission allow side across the report and its downloads.
sense_reason: Three steps; expected 3 says what to do if the build disagrees.

title: Without reports access Work In Progress is absent from the navigation
reason: Permission block side.
sense_reason: Two steps; the note also asks for the direct-URL probe.

title: Column Selection toggles columns; Total is not offered at all
reason: Column-selection control, its verbatim tooltip, and the Total-cannot-be-hidden invariant.
sense_reason: Three steps.

title: Toggling columns never reorders them (Total always last)
reason: Order stability under toggling plus the all-tabs-share-one-selection rule; the first half re-asserts WIP-COL-01's fixed order.
sense_reason: Three steps; the cross-tab check is the part only this case makes.

title: Remembers the date range, filter selections, location, columns
reason: Persistence of seven settings plus the active tab, and the per-browser (not per-account) scope.
sense_reason: Four steps.

title: A saved setting that is no longer valid falls back to its default
reason: Defensive restore of a stale saved setting.
sense_reason: Two steps.

title: Status-to-tab mapping: Estimate, Complete, In Progress and Review work orders
reason: The status-to-tab mapping and the nowhere-else exclusivity.
sense_reason: Four seeded work orders, one per status.

title: Approved started-boundary: time or part received vs neither decides the tab
reason: The started-boundary rule - clocked time OR a received part decides which Approved tab a job lands in. The subtlest placement rule in the report.
sense_reason: Three deliberately-shaped Approved work orders covering both started kinds and neither.

title: Every open service WO at a selected location appears in the report
reason: All five open statuses qualify - the inclusion half of the row-scope contract.
sense_reason: Five seeded work orders, one per status.

title: Invoiced; Paid and part-sale work orders never appear
reason: Invoiced, Paid and part-sale work orders excluded from rows, totals, the strip AND the download - a four-surface negative (Rule 40).
sense_reason: Four steps covering all four surfaces.

title: Each qualifying work order appears exactly once in exactly one tab
reason: Each qualifying job appears exactly once in exactly one tab, and a nothing-approved job still appears.
sense_reason: Three steps.

title: While loading the standard indicator shows and old rows stay until data
reason: Loading indicator behaviour; a near-duplicate of PV-NAV-03, TU-NAV-05 and SBR-STATE-03 across reports.
sense_reason: Two steps.

title: No qualifying work orders: every tab shows the no-data message and no Totals
reason: The no-data state across all four tabs, the (0) counts, and the one-empty-tab-among-populated-tabs case.
sense_reason: Verbatim message; three steps covering both shapes of emptiness.

title: The initial sort is Days Open with the longest-open work order first
reason: The initial Days Open descending sort - the report's opening priority order.
sense_reason: Two steps.

title: Clicking a header sorts ascending, clicking again toggles descending
reason: Sort toggle semantics, no third state, and one column at a time.
sense_reason: Four steps including the third click.

title: Columns sort by underlying values; Asset sorts by the identifier shown
reason: Sort by underlying value versus text, and the Asset sort key following the PO-ruled identifier.
sense_reason: Five steps; the note admits the mixed-identifier sort key is unpinned.

title: Sorting reorders only the active tab's rows; Totals stays at the bottom
reason: Sort scope is the active tab only and the Totals row stays out of the sort.
sense_reason: Three steps.

title: The summary strip shows seven figures in a fixed order as US dollars
reason: The seven summary figures, their order and their currency format.
sense_reason: Closed list version-pinned to WIP v6 S5-R1 - Rule 42 satisfied.

title: Total Earned is the hero figure and equals the started-stage figures summed
reason: Hero styling plus the Total Earned = Started-Earned + Ready to Invoice identity - a money contract.

title: Total Remaining equals Not Started plus Started — Remaining
reason: The Total Remaining identity.
sense_reason: Two steps.

title: Each per-stage figure equals the matching tab's money total
reason: Each per-stage figure ties to its own tab's money total - the strip-versus-tab reconciliation, and the strongest case in this area.
sense_reason: Three steps, one per tie; the note warns to drop the on-screen filters first.

title: The Estimates figure is the Estimates tab's total quoted value, shown muted
reason: The Estimates figure is the quoted value, muted, and excluded from the two totals - it found a real $0.00 defect.

title: Each summary figure's information icon reveals its plain explanation
reason: Seven verbatim tooltip texts plus hover/focus/tap - one case where a lesser suite would have written fourteen.
sense_reason: Word-for-word comparison instructed explicitly.

title: Work In Progress appears in the reports navigation under the Performance group
reason: Navigation placement and the verbatim browser page title.
sense_reason: Version-pinned closed title string - Rule 42 satisfied.

title: Four tabs in a fixed order with the partially-completed tab selected
reason: Four tabs, their order, the default tab, and the explicit absence of a status filter.
sense_reason: Closed list version-pinned to WIP v6 S1-R2 - Rule 42 satisfied.

title: There is no Trend / over-time tab or chart
reason: The deliberate absence of a Trend view; an absence-of-feature case, though it does guard against a premature surface reading the snapshot history.

title: Each tab has a Totals row pinned to the bottom, labeled "Totals"
reason: A Totals row per tab, its label, and its pinned bold Total cell.
sense_reason: Three steps across every tab.

reason: The Totals row sums every visible money column and the Inv. Hrs column with its sign and colour.

title: Each tab uses an all-white table with no alternating row shading
reason: All-white table and no zebra striping; cosmetic.

reason: The summary strip renders as one ruled band rather than separate cards; cosmetic.

reason: Totals visible during vertical scroll and the no-second-scrollbar layout rule; cosmetic.

reason: Info icons keyboard-reachable, revealed on focus not hover alone, and exposed to assistive technology - the same pattern that failed live on Sales By Representative.

reason: Dark-mode legibility across five named elements; cosmetic.
